bio.text: Alissa Ellman, a U.S. Army veteran, won the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026 for New York's 24th Congressional District and will face Republican Rep. Claudia Tenney in the November 3 general election.
After her Army deployment ended in 2004 she worked as a military contractor in Afghanistan for four more years, and until 2025 she was a file clerk at the Buffalo VA.
WSKG reported in July 2025 that she is an Allegany County native and a Lockport resident, and that she became a teacher after leaving the military.

sources.title: Ellman wins Democratic nomination for NY-24 seat, will face Rep. Tenney in November
Third Democratic candidate seeks to unseat Rep. Claudia Tenney
